integration.description: Whether the shell reports its prompts and each command's exit code (shell integration: OSC 133 marks from a small script Eludite sources for bash, zsh, fish and PowerShell when the setting terminal.shellIntegration is on). Without it (`sh`, a shell that declined, or the setting off) a prompt is recognized by a heuristic: the cursor's line ends in `$ `, `> ` or `# ` after 300 ms without output, and exit codes per command are unknown.

mark.description: A position in the terminal's output stream: the number of bytes of plain text (UTF-8, escape sequences removed) the terminal has printed since it started. Pass it to eludite.terminal.read (`mode: since`) or eludite.terminal.wait to see only what came after it.
